title: Explore scalable web systems
description: Nine short modules connect scaling claims, agent-supported development, measurement, architecture, pressure, and engineering decisions. Your progress stays in this browser.

modules.title: Understand scaling pressure
modules.description: Name the pressure, predict an ideal speedup, and distinguish a model from evidence.

modules.title: Make agent work reviewable
modules.description: Bound a change, exercise acceptance gates, and improve the feedback loop.

modules.title: Design a useful measurement
modules.description: Choose a measurement boundary, explore Little’s Law, and write a reproducible experiment.

modules.title: Follow a request across boundaries
modules.description: Locate authority, inspect an uncertain write, and state an architectural hypothesis.

modules.title: Find the cost around a change
modules.description: Separate workflow costs, experiment with illustrative timings, and test one improvement.

modules.title: Expose an assumption under pressure
modules.description: Trace a failure chain, examine retry safety, and design a discriminating pressure test.

modules.title: Bound parallel agent work
modules.description: Define task contracts, explore sequential limits, and preserve integration evidence.

modules.title: Choose and test a scaling response
modules.description: Find a binding limit, move it in a model, and test the cost introduced by an intervention.

modules.title: Make a conditional engineering decision
modules.description: Separate observation from explanation, compare consequences, and identify the next check.
